target_customer: Commercial lunar and deep space missions that cannot get time on NASA's oversubscribed Deep Space Network; spacecraft makers using its design software
problem: Deep space missions lack reliable commercial ground station capacity, and spacecraft communication system design is slow.
business_model: Ground network communications as a service plus design software (Cascade Designer)
product_category: Deep space ground station network and RF design software

founders.name: Jacob Portukalian
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as architect of communications systems at those companies.

founders.name: Arlen Abraham
founders.background_notes: YC page: generalist across hardware, firmware, product and business; aerospace, consumer goods, communications, energy.

technical_complexity.rationale: Large aperture ground stations that downlink from lunar distance need hardware, RF engineering, site permitting and spectrum licensing; very hard for a seven person team.

defensibility.rationale: Capital intensity, spectrum and site approvals and RF expertise raise barriers, but well funded space communications players could enter.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action against Cascade found; NASA is moving toward commercial services for near space only, per search results.

market_need_then: The company states the Deep Space Network is oversubscribed and unavailable to commercial missions as lunar missions multiply.

branding.domain_note: Site at cascadespace.com; one directory mentions a former name Heliosphere Network, unverified.

identity.voice_and_tone: Bold and ambitious (Your Signal. Our Mission.).

brand_strength.rationale: Seed round got trade press, but nothing about the brand itself; the name Cascade is common.

outcome_analysis: Cascade Space raised a 5.9M seed in July 2025 after the Spring 2025 batch and is active, with the first lunar downlink station Earth Station Zero planned for 2026 and no confirmation that it has happened. Founders have SpaceX communications backgrounds. Execution risk is hardware, licensing and capital, and no later round was found.
notes: Seed amount confirmed by press release plus Pulse 2.0 and Satellite Today coverage. Investor names come from VCBacked and NewSpaceTracker aggregators (names present in both are listed); NewSpaceTracker also lists Nova Threshold, Undeterred Capital, Olive Capital, Hawktail and Garage Capital, and the lead is disputed (Seedtable YC, ZoomInfo Olive Capital). Solar Daily headline says 59M, which conflicts and is treated as an error. Exact date taken from the BusinessWire release ID and search summary (July 24, 2025). Later rounds not checked beyond search; coverage partial. No commercial deep space competitor dated near the batch was found, so the list is empty. Founder education not on YC page.
